body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

During a routine retail inspection in Market Beta on 24 Nov, our inspectors recorded the pack with
unique identifier PK-PL-01-6U4NNZG5 (Horizon Blue KS 20).

In accordance with the reporting obligations for Market Beta, please provide the full trace of this
pack: production site and line, date and time of commissioning, the aggregation hierarchy (bundle,
shipping case, pallet), the shipment with its dispatch and arrival times, and the receiving distributor.

Please respond within two business days, quoting reference BRS-TR-2026-0417.

Yours faithfully,
Trace Requests Desk
Beta Revenue and Stamp Office

subject: Delay notice - SHP-20261123-PL01-BETD1 - revised ETA

Update on shipment SHP-20261123-PL01-BETD1 (Factory PL-01 to Beta North Distributor, 12 pallets):

- Actual departure:  24 Nov 2026 16:00 UTC (26 hours late - tractor unit breakdown, replacement truck)
